name: Pahrump
seo_title: Christmas Events for Kids in Pahrump, NV 2026
seo_desc: Kids' Christmas in Pahrump, NV: the KNYE tree lighting, Cookies with Santa and the PDOP train, Winter Wonder Slam and free community dinners.
lede: Pahrump celebrates Christmas as a small town that shows up together: a radio-station tree lighting, free Santa nights and free community dinners run by local volunteers.
celebrates: The season opens with the KNYE Radio Community Christmas Tree Lighting in the Pahrump Nugget parking lot, where Santa arrives on a fire engine and the Pahrump Community Choir sings. The Pahrump Disability Outreach Program hosts Cookies with Santa with its own train and mechanical reindeer. A free wrestling show, Winter Wonder Slam, gives Nye County kids free treats and toys. The Pahrump Holiday Task Force serves free community dinners at Thanksgiving and on Christmas Eve, and the Pahrump Community Library adds ornament crafts. Locals follow the weekly Upcoming Events column in the Pahrump Valley Times to catch the rest.
lastyear: In 2025 the Winter Wonder Slam came to Pahrump on Sunday, December 21, with free food, free stockings and toys for kids, and its organizers report that more than 2,300 people attended. The Pahrump Holiday Task Force served a free community Christmas dinner on Wednesday, December 24, from 11 am. KNYE Radio held its 12th tree lighting in the Pahrump Nugget parking lot, according to the Pahrump Valley Times.
facts: The Pahrump community tree was once a live evergreen that KNYE host Karen Jackson bought fresh every year. It first stood in a vacant lot next to the Saddle West before moving to the Pahrump Nugget parking lot. In 2014 she raised money for an artificial tree that could be reused, and the lighting ceremony began that year. Crews from Valley Electric Association raise the tree each November with utility trucks and top it with a large star.
trains: Pahrump's own train is a small one: the Pahrump Disability Outreach Program runs its PDOP train at Cookies with Santa, along with a mechanical reindeer. For a full-size ride, the Nevada State Railroad Museum in Boulder City runs 45-minute train rides on the old Boulder City Branch Line, with Santa Trains in the Christmas season. Check the museum page before you plan the trip, because tickets and schedules differ by date.

traditions: Radio station KNYE lights the tree in the Pahrump Nugget parking lot with caroling, cookies, cocoa and Santa.
The Pahrump Disability Outreach Program offers a free family evening with Santa, treats, a train and a mechanical reindeer.
A free pro wrestling show where Nye County's kids are the guests of honor, with free treats and toys.
The Pahrump Holiday Task Force serves free meals on both holidays, run by volunteers and sponsors.
The Pahrump Community Library holds ornament craft parties with sign-up required and materials provided.
kidfact: The Pahrump community Christmas tree started as a real evergreen. Today it is an artificial tree that can be put up again every year.
faq: When is the Pahrump Christmas tree lighting?

The KNYE Radio Community Christmas Tree Lighting is held on the Saturday after Thanksgiving in the Pahrump Nugget parking lot. In 2026 that is November 28, with community time from 5 pm and the lighting at 6 pm. The event is free and includes cocoa, cookies, caroling and Santa.
Where can kids meet Santa in Pahrump?

Santa visits the KNYE tree lighting at the Pahrump Nugget and the Pahrump Disability Outreach Program's Cookies with Santa on the Nye Communities Coalition campus. Both are free in 2026. Check each event listing on this page for the exact date, time and what is included before you go.
Are there free Christmas events in Pahrump?

Yes. The tree lighting, Cookies with Santa, Winter Wonder Slam and the Christmas Eve community dinner are all free in 2026, according to their hosts. The Pahrump Holiday Task Force says every one of its events is free to attend thanks to donations, sponsors and volunteers.
Is there a Christmas Eve dinner in Pahrump?

The Pahrump Holiday Task Force serves a free community Christmas dinner on Christmas Eve. In 2026 it runs from 11 am to 2 pm on Thursday, December 24. The Task Force lists Nye Communities Coalition on Wilson Road as the location, so confirm on its website before you go.
Is there a train ride in Pahrump?

Pahrump has the small PDOP train at Cookies with Santa. For a full-size Christmas train, the Nevada State Railroad Museum in Boulder City runs Santa Trains on the Boulder City Branch Line. See the Las Vegas guide for the current Boulder City listing and ticket details.
